title: Monotonicity of reachable sets
statement: Let $K$ be a natural number, let $R$ be a binary relation on the natural numbers, and let $	ext{Init}$ be a predicate on the natural numbers. For each natural number $L$, let the reachable set consist of those numbers below $K$ that can be reached in at most $L$ steps from some number below $K$ satisfying $	ext{Init}$, where each step follows $R$ to a number below $K$. If $L �a4 L'$, then the reachable set for $L$ is contained in the reachable set for $L'$.
